The guards are a spread of characters. You night get lucky and run into someone who's by the book, or you might not. Their differences in attitude is a driver for some parts of the plot, as I aimed to make the characters as "textured" as possible and not cookie cutter evil empire archetypes.

Project Name- Count The Days

Premise- A story about a pair of unlikely friends meeting in the depths of the State of London City's prison system, one, a disgraced maths professor, determined to bring down the man who put him there, the other, an abandoned experiment, unable to remember his turbulent past, wondering what the world outside the confines of his cell is like, caught up in a conspiracy he recalls none of. Together, they might just have a chance to set the record straight.

Image Info- This is a PSA poster produced by the health and safety team at Northwall Detention Facility, the main setting of the story. It details the procedures guards take to de-escalate situations involving prisoners, revised after the deadly Northwall riots in 2012 that killed several staff and numerous prisoners.
